You know, when I first made it to[school] today, I thought to myself, “Today is going to be a simple day.”
lines.zh: 你知道吗，今天我刚到[school]的时候，我对自己说，“今天会是简单的一天。”

lines.en: “I’ve started to slip back into my routine after getting caught up in the clouds and, all things considered, I’m feeling pretty decent.”
lines.zh: “在陷进云里一阵子之后，我已经开始重新滑回我的日常，而总的来说，我感觉相当不错。”

lines.en: But, as you can tell by the person in front of me, today is apparently going to be anything but simple.
lines.zh: 但是，正如你看到我面前这个人就明白的，今天显然注定绝不简单。

lines.en: So here’s hoping whatever Kirin decides to do to (Or {i}with{/i}) me today doesn’t take very long so I can go back to being an oversized ball of nothing.
lines.zh: 所以只希望 Kirin 今天决定对我做的（或者{i}和{/i}我做的）事别花太久，好让我能回去当一个超大的虚无球体。

lines.en: : What’s got your panties in a bunch, Sensei? I figured you’d be happy to have your favorite sex addict drop by after[school].

lines.en: : Who said you’re my favorite sex addict?
lines.zh: : 谁说你是我最喜欢的性瘾患者了？

lines.en: : Well, it’s me or Ayane. And I like threesomes more, so clearly I’m the favorite.
lines.zh: : 嗯，要么是我，要么是 Ayane。而我更喜欢三人行，所以显然我是那个最爱的。

lines.en: : Ayane would probably like them a little more if her only experiences with them weren’t forced and traumatic.
lines.zh: : 如果 Ayane 唯一的那几次三人行经历不是被强迫且充满创伤的话，她大概会更喜欢一点。

lines.en: : She came. You came. We all came.
lines.zh: : 她高潮了。你高潮了。我们都高潮了。

lines.en: : When did you-
lines.zh: : 你什么时候——

lines.en: : Unimportant.
lines.zh: : 不重要。

lines.en: scene kirinayaneoffice2
: What {i}is{/i} important, though, is that we all emerged from that as better friends.
lines.zh: : 重要的{i}是{/i}，我们从那之后都变成了更好的朋友。

lines.en: : I think you may have gravely misinterpreted how both of those events ended.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你可能严重误读了那两件事的结局。

lines.en: : Probably. I might have been a little distracted by the monster cock spewing buckets of cum into a girl I’ve known since the training bra days.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。我可能有点分心——被那根怪物鸡巴往一个我从她穿训练胸罩的年代就认识的女孩身上喷了一桶又一桶精液分了心。

lines.en: : What a shame that {i}she{/i} grew up but you never did.
lines.zh: : 真遗憾，{i}她{/i}长大了，而你从来没有。

lines.en: scene kirinayaneoffice3
: Very funny. But I’ll have you know that staying on the small side, if things {i}do{/i} remain that way for me, will give me a {i}lot{/i} more wardrobe options in the future. So ha.

lines.en: : Besides, those B cups of hers barely constitute growing up to begin with.

lines.en: : You know what? How about we stop talking about Ayane for a second and talk about something or...someone that you don’t get a rise out of tormenting?

lines.en: scene kirinayaneoffice1

lines.zh: : 没错。你只不过为了这个，把 Ayane 的一点点理智给交易掉了——而我觉得说到底这挺值的。

lines.en: : Again, can we please not talk about Ayane?

lines.en: scene kirinayaneoffice6
